Charred broccoli, 15 minutes, serves 2

2-3 tbsp olive oil
1 head broccoli
a splash of red wine vinegar
a few sprigs of thyme
½ tsp chilli flakes

Get a pan very hot. Break the broccoli into pieces and char them in the olive oil without moving them about. Add the thyme and chilli flakes near the end. Finish with a splash of vinegar off the heat.
